# Growthbook <> Ecovadis - Demo
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 83.55999755859375m

## Summary
The evaluation focuses on improving supplier personalization while addressing personalization gaps, legacy tooling constraints, and engineering dependency. Web testing is prioritized, with server-side testing also considered; mobile testing is excluded. JavaScript web and server-side SDKs connect application surfaces, support runtime feature evaluation, and use programmatic attributes or cookie and storage data for supplier segmentation. Databricks remains the read-only data source for exposure events and SQL-based experiment analysis. Capabilities include feature flags, remote content control, self-service visual and DOM-based experiments, Bayesian or frequentist analysis, metric-based recommendations, gradual rollouts, guardrail monitoring, and automatic feature disabling. Claude integration, natural-language experiment creation, configurable approvals, risk-based governance, namespace traffic separation, alerts, and Slack notifications were discussed. Follow-up needs include implementation guidance, go-to-market examples, overlap visibility, and internal stakeholder discussion. The evaluation extends through December, with a possible extension into 2027.

## Keywords
Experimentation, Feature flags, Databricks, Claude MCP, Supplier personalization, Experiment governance
